title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Static 72 - Affinity 100%

preimages.meaning: 中文：强制效果 ID 0x1B 的 PPC 直接检查返回真。 / English: Force the direct PPC check for effect ID 0x1B to return true.
中文：将第一条会心加成从 30 改为 100。 / English: Change the first affinity addition from 30 to 100.
中文：强制效果 ID 0x1B 的 PPC 直接检查返回真。 / English: Force the direct PPC check for effect ID 0x1B to return true.
中文：将第二条会心加成从 30 改为 100。 / English: Change the second affinity addition from 30 to 100.

anchors.meaning: 中文：调用前把效果 ID 0x1B 放入 PPC 参数 r4。 / English: Loads effect ID 0x1B into PPC argument r4 before the call.
中文：调用前把效果 ID 0x1B 放入 PPC 参数 r4。 / English: Loads effect ID 0x1B into PPC argument r4 before the call.

known_risks: 中文：Wii U 编译结果把 #72 的核心逻辑折叠到与 #6 相同的两条会心路径；两项当前等效且不可同时启用。 / English: The Wii U build folds #72's core behavior into the same two affinity paths as #6; the two are currently equivalent and cannot be enabled together.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #72“会心率 100%”转换为 JP v96 Wii U PPC 固定地址补丁；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #72 "Affinity 100%" into fixed-address JP-v96 Wii U PPC patches; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
